conversations.title: CFO in Germany, consent banner not answered
messages: Hi, I'm the CFO at Alpenblick Logistik, about 640 employees. We are evaluating tools to replace our month-end close. Do you have a DATEV integration?

conversations.title: A tempting answer the content does not support

messages.text: We run SAP Business One. Do you integrate with SAP Business One?

recordedDraft.text: Yes, Northwind Ledger connects to SAP Business One through a certified connector.
Every object in Northwind Ledger is available through a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks.

messages: I'm the head of finance, 300 employees, and we want a demo this month.

conversations.title: UK visitor from an account an AE already works
messages: Where is our data hosted? Does it stay in the EU?
I'm the finance director, 711 employees, we'd like to book a demo.

conversations.title: Existing customer with a support problem
messages: Our invoices are not syncing to SAP since yesterday, we already use Northwind.

questionnaire.text: Is your organisation certified to ISO 27001?
In which countries is customer data stored, including backups?
When was the last independent penetration test of the web application?
List all subprocessors that process customer personal data.
Is customer data used to train AI models?
When is customer data deleted after the contract ends?
Do you hold a BSI C5 attestation?
State your recovery time objective and recovery point objective.

tags.quote: Our subsidiaries run B1; without a connector this is a non-starter.
We would need B1 for the Austrian entity.
Our bank customers require data in Switzerland.
Security asked whether we can bring our own keys.
Same deal: Swiss hosting came up again in the security review.
Could payroll journals flow in automatically?
Can we get a better price?
